meta.name: NG exhaustion-chain Phase-2 curated brain extension proposal
meta.brain_edit_policy: Do not edit research/kalshi/knowledge/ng_brain.json directly from this file. Merge only after deliberate adjudication.
meta.purpose: Capture the durable lessons from the finalized Phase-2 55-week exhaustion-chain characterization while preserving provisional mechanisms, future candidate queues, execution separation, and explicit do-not-learn boundaries.

preserve_from_parent_proposal: Exhaustion runway state is a lifespan/remaining-authority problem, strongest validated domain Family A.
Persistent A has materially longer runway than fast-collapse A; keep frozen reveal duration baselines and no holdout retuning.
Same-side post-event microstructure raises confidence and opposite-side flow lowers confidence; confidence-only unless separately frozen.
Never learn scratch curve-generator coefficients, magnitude rules, or curve scores.

merge_ready_general_lessons.call: At roughly 20-60 second information horizons, several recent exhaustion aftermaths can jointly carry reproducible causal information, especially D2-D4. Treat this as higher-order rolling state, not a universal monotonic origin chain.
merge_ready_general_lessons.guard: Structural depth does not automatically authorize execution; causal availability remains mandatory.

merge_ready_general_lessons.call: Use a rolling/re-origin state-machine prior. When a new exhaustion becomes causally established, treat it as a candidate new checkpoint and require older ancestry to re-earn incremental OOT value before assuming it remains active.
merge_ready_general_lessons.guard: Re-origin does not mean ancestry is erased and does not imply automatic exit or reversal. Exact detector availability can make a structural successor unsuitable for managing an already-open short parent trade.

merge_ready_general_lessons.call: Distinguish structural onset from causally established detector identity. A successor that exists retrospectively cannot be used at a live decision until every frozen detector dependency required to identify it is actually available.
merge_ready_general_lessons.evidence: For valid P-O-X parents, 496 base and 11 held immediate successors began strictly before the normal parent +60 exit, but exact canonical successor identity was unavailable before that exit in every case; the closest base miss was 81 seconds.
merge_ready_general_lessons.guard: Never synthesize an earlier identity by silently changing the frozen detector.

merge_ready_general_lessons.call: A failed fold or losing subtype is a forensic trigger, not an automatic deletion. Preserve valid true and false instances and decompose before retirement.
retirement_requires: repeated independent OOT failure after mechanism decomposition
or a predeclared falsifier showing null behavior across relevant blocks
merge_ready_general_lessons.guard: Do not rescue a mechanism by deleting inconvenient rows or inventing held-selected filters.

merge_ready_general_lessons.call: Most strict exhaustion chains are short and concentrated inside minutes; genuine long fixed-origin tails exist but are sparse and heterogeneous. Preserve the long tail for research without imposing a universal long-chain cutoff.

Separate short-lag delayed re-expression of an unresolved thread from a later fresh trusted setup. Recovery by +120/+300 can occur without a new full motif; hours-later trusted reappearance should be attributed as a fresh/re-origin setup unless inherited causality is independently proven.

Higher-order chains reuse smaller direction-invariant state/polarity modules across otherwise different full chains. Pair and triplet building blocks can recur even when the whole ancestry does not repeat identically.
merge_ready_general_lessons.evidence: Examples inside strict D2+ lineages include PP|S, PO|S, OO|F, OP|F, XP|F and triplets such as PPP|SS and PPX|SS across multiple OOT blocks and held.
merge_ready_general_lessons.guard: Module recurrence is a structural lesson, not automatic authorization to trade a listed motif.

merge_ready_general_lessons.call: Chain lifespan has recurring timing families rather than one universal duration. Exact D2 separates into a short body, middle body, and rare long tail; exact D3 has a short body and longer tail. The timing-family mix replicates better than the exact module composition inside each family.
merge_ready_general_lessons.evidence: Exact D2 centers are approximately 126s, 215s, and 798s; exact D3 centers are approximately 211s and 609s. Held assignments preserve the broad family proportions better than the exact grammar inside each family.
merge_ready_general_lessons.guard: Do not turn fitted timing centers into hard live cutoffs; D4/D5 remain too sparse for a stable timing-family doctrine.

provisional_research_memory_do_not_promo.call: P-O-X is a branching transition precursor rather than one universal fixed-horizon continuation state. Keep all valid instances and resolve its branches causally.
When current exhaustion polarity is opposite the immediately preceding X-state exhaustion, P-O-X is the strongest current executable subcandidate.
provisional_research_memory_do_not_promo.why_not_promoted: It requires a dedicated future prospective/OOT promotion study; Phase 2 did not freeze a new play.

provisional_research_memory_do_not_promo.call: P-O-X followed by same-polarity current can enter a short adverse phase and later re-express. The parent still exits normally at +60; only after flat may the completed path prioritize delayed-reexpression watch state.

postexit_watch_geometry.shallow_adverse_definition: no worse than -1 tick at +30 and exactly -1 tick at +60
postexit_watch_geometry.deep_persistent_definition: -2 ticks or worse at both +30 and +60

provisional_research_memory_do_not_promo.guard: Recovery probability is not positive expected return and does not authorize automatic re-entry. Some +120 recoveries relapse by +300. Another trade still requires a trusted full setup.

provisional_research_memory_do_not_promo.call: SSO is early watch only; fully causal SSOS is armed state for the existing frozen SSOS paper play.
provisional_research_memory_do_not_promo.evidence: SSO completed into SSOS about 21-24% across OOT blocks with several minutes median lead; full SSOS completion was about 91-96% pre-held with roughly 37-48 seconds median lead.
provisional_research_memory_do_not_promo.guard: Partial prefixes never authorize entry by themselves.

provisional_research_memory_do_not_promo.call: P or P-O alone are background context. Fully causal P-O-X is an armed watch for the next exhaustion's polarity resolution, not itself a guaranteed entry.
provisional_research_memory_do_not_promo.evidence: Complete causal P-O-X resolved into the priority opposite-current branch roughly 28-33% across OOT blocks with roughly 14-23 seconds median lead when completion occurred.

provisional_research_memory_do_not_promo.call: Take a valid P-O-X parent trade and let it reach its frozen normal structural endpoint+60 exit. Reset only after exit, then watch and re-enter only when a later trusted SSOS or P-O-X-opposite setup becomes fully causal.
provisional_research_memory_do_not_promo.support: After the normal exit, 650/666 base parents and 13/13 held parents reached a later trusted target before weekly close. All first trusted targets had every required predecessor h=60 information-availability timestamp after the parent exit.
provisional_research_memory_do_not_promo.guard: Do not invent a synthetic early successor detector or use future canonical identity to manage the open parent.

provisional_research_memory_do_not_promo.call: Reusable causal predecessor motifs exist beyond SSOS and P-O-X-opposite. Preserve them as an independent candidate atlas for future OOT work, not as frozen plays.

overlap_sanity.POX_to_FLIP: zero unique instances after known P-O-X-opposite removal
overlap_sanity.SOS_to_FLIP: loses stable confirmation after SSOS overlap removal

provisional_research_memory_do_not_promo.guard: The novelty screen is exploratory and many-pattern. No multiple-testing-adjusted play promotion was performed, and an AGAINST_CURRENT structural orientation is not an automatically authorized reversal trade.

provisional_research_memory_do_not_promo.call: Some strict D1 pair modules have above-baseline probability of extending to D2 across chronological blocks. PP|S, XP|F and PP|F are current examples; OP|F is an investigator example because held falls below its unusually high block baseline.
provisional_research_memory_do_not_promo.guard: Extension propensity is structural lineage information, not an executable entry rule. D2->D3 families exist but are sparse; D4/D5 are too sparse to force a family doctrine.

frozen_execution_reference_not_brain_pro.note: Keep execution evidence separate from general forecasting knowledge. Phase 2 did not change this play and froze no additional play.

future_research_not_a_phase2_blocker: prospective/OOT promotion study for P-O-X opposite-current
candidate-specific promotion studies for any independent recurrence module selected later
additional D4/D5 timing-family research if future sample size becomes sufficient
selective older-ancestry tests at specific future re-origin subtypes

explicit_do_not_learn_or_promote: a universal D2-or-deeper law from aggregate structural gain
a universal short/long time cutoff or Gaussian-mixture timing center as a live rule
the assumption that one fixed origin remains active through every descendant
the assumption that a successor exhaustion automatically requires exit or reversal
a synthetic early successor identity that the frozen detector cannot know causally
P or P-O partial prefixes as trade entries
a shallow same-current post-exit recovery subtype as a trade entry or automatic re-entry
hours-later trusted reappearance as proof of same-origin persistence
fixed +10/+30 management proxies as permanent rules
specific recurrence-atlas pair/triplet motifs as frozen plays without separate prospective/OOT promotion
an AGAINST_CURRENT structural module as an automatically authorized reversal trade
held-selected long-tail module composition as a universal long-chain grammar
P-O-X opposite branch as a frozen play before further prospective/OOT validation

merge_shape_when_approved.chain_role: rolling higher-order context, causal identity availability, modular recurrence, timing-family context, and re-origin doctrine
